---

SQLite's command-line shell works out of the box with a simple prompt:

```yaml
extensions:
  term:
    shell: sqlite3
    prompt: "sqlite>"
    init:
      - ".mode column"
      - ".headers on"
```

## Creating Tables

```{term}
CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, age INTEGER);
INSERT INTO users VALUES (1, 'Alice', 30), (2, 'Bob', 25), (3, 'Charlie', 35);
```

## Queries

```{term}
SELECT * FROM users;
SELECT name, age FROM users WHERE age > 28 ORDER BY age DESC;
```

## Aggregation

```{term}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, AVG(age) AS avg_age, MIN(age) AS youngest, MAX(age) AS oldest FROM users;
```

## Schema Inspection

```{term}
.schema users
.tables
```
